column1: # Game profile of Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.4.2 = v393216). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone

# Nintendo EPD Tokyo's engine (the al library over sead / agl, as Super Mario 3D World and Super Mario Odyssey; NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk), SDK 8.2.0 (the sdk build Link's Awakening 1.1.0 runs), NVN;
# main exports its symbols (48,804 defined). RomFS is almost entirely Yaz0-compressed SARC archives (.szs).
# Shaders: bfsha (BNSH) in ShaderData, agl sharcb (BAHS) and layout BNSH in SystemData, particle effects in EffectData (BNSH), and BNSH in main: 7,258 shaders.
# The one that does not build is the fin fur geometry shader (RenderFinFur), as in 3D World: Metal has no geometry stage.
# main imports glslcCompile and holds agl's GLSL sources, but no module defines it: nothing compiles at run time

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# Handheld: docked, the game's pointer (touch blocks, stunning enemies) is the Joy-Con gyro, which the host does not have; handheld, it is the touch screen,
# which the iPhone front end feeds with the touches no gamepad control takes. Handheld also renders at 720p
# the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# only the merged 1.4.2 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. main's bss is only 1.4 MB. 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region
# + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region), as the other EPD games without virtual address memory
